title: feat: ChromaticAberration component — RGB channel separation post-process
body:
## Summary

- `ChromaticAberration` `Component` in `bsengine-core` — attaches to a camera for color fringing
- `intensity` in UV-space units (>= 0); 0.02 = subtle, >0.1 = heavy distortion
- `ChromaticAberration::subtle()` convenience constructor (0.02 intensity)

## Test plan

- [ ] CI All Green (4 unit tests)
- [ ] subtle() default: 0.02 intensity, enabled
- [ ] intensity clamped to >= 0
- [ ] with_intensity() builder
- [ ] disabled() sets enabled = false
